entities.summary: Magdalena Matte Lecaros is a Chilean businesswoman and politician. She is member of the Independent Democratic Union (UDI) and was part of Chile's Ministry of Housing and Urban Development under Chile's former President Sebastián Piñera for the term of 2010–2014. She is a member of the Matte family. Magdalena Matte was a performers & entertainers from Santiago (b. 1950-08-13, Santiago). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
